implementation_notes: This document is a one-page provisional English overview slide summarizing Japan's Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of AI-related Technology (AI Act), rather than the operative statutory text itself. The Act was established on 2025-05-28, with partial enforcement on 2025-06-04 and full enforcement on 2025-09-01. It establishes the AI Strategic Headquarters chaired by the Prime Minister, provides for an AI Basic Plan, and outlines non-punitive measures including information collection, investigation of rights infringements, and guidance, advice, and announcements to business operators and citizens.
